flows/ai_coach_chat_flow_test.dart.why: Sends a message in the Vana general chat (/jade redirects there): one model turn per run, and the answer is not deterministic.

flows/meal_plan_build_flow_test.dart.why: Generates a new Vana plan: the opener and every picker turn call vana-chat / vana-action. A testing wave caps new plans at three.

flows/onboarding_signup_flow_test.dart.why: Needs a fresh install with no session; it self-skips once an earlier flow has signed in, and the job fails on any skip.

flows/account_delete_flow_test.dart.why: Signs up throwaway accounts from the welcome screen, so it needs a fresh install with no session, like the signup flow.

flows/google_login_flow_test.dart.why: Drives the native Google account sheet, which needs interactive consent; it self-skips on iOS.
